full_prompt_en: A square blue-hour photograph shows a small coastal house at the end of a quiet road, with a large tree on the left and a luminous twilight sky behind both. The upper half is an open, saturated cyan-blue field with almost no cloud detail. It shifts lower down into bands of violet, pink, and coral-orange just above a low, dark horizon. This smooth color transition makes the still air feel unusually clear and gives the simple setting a vivid backdrop. The tree occupies the left third as a deep navy silhouette, its drooping foliage and forked trunks forming an organic counterweight to the house. Thin vertical posts and faint wires extend around it. On the right, the little one-story house has a sloping dark roof and walls tinted cool turquoise by the ambient blue light. A single rectangular window glows amber, and a small warm pool spills from the doorway onto the ground. A tall utility pole rises beside the roof, with wires cutting delicate horizontal lines across the colored lower sky. The road enters from the bottom center and leads toward the house and distant water; a small parked car sits near its end. The immediate ground stays dark and nearly textureless, letting the clean silhouettes and bands of color remain dominant. The sky supplies broad cool illumination, while the window and doorway are the only concentrated warm light sources; no strong sunlight or hard cast shadows remain. The composition feels quiet and inhabited, balancing large luminous negative space with a modest building, a dark tree, and a few warm signs of life at the edge of evening.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形蓝调时分照片呈现安静道路尽头的一栋海边小屋，左侧有一棵大树，两者后面是发亮的暮色天空。上半幅是开阔、饱和的青蓝色域，几乎没有云层细节。它向下逐渐转为紫色、粉色和珊瑚橙色条带，停在低暗地平线上方。平滑的色彩过渡让静止的空气显得格外清澈，也为简单场景提供鲜明背景。树以深海军蓝剪影占据左侧三分之一，下垂枝叶和分叉树干构成小屋的有机对重。细长竖杆与淡淡电线在它周围延伸。右侧的小单层房屋有斜斜的深色屋顶，墙面被环境蓝光染成冷青绿。一扇矩形窗户发出琥珀光，小片暖光从门口洒到地面。一根高电线杆在屋顶旁升起，电线在下方彩色天空中切出细水平线。道路从下方中央进入，通往小屋和远水；一辆小汽车停在道路尽头附近。近处地面深暗，几乎没有纹理，让干净的剪影与色带保持主导。天空提供宽广冷光，窗户和门口是仅有的集中暖光源；强烈日光与硬投影都已消退。构图安静而有人居气息，用大片发亮负空间平衡一栋谦逊小屋、一棵深色树和黄昏边缘少数温暖的生活迹象。
style_prompt_en: A blue-hour photographic treatment places an expansive saturated cyan-blue field above a narrow sequence of violet, hot pink, and coral-orange bands. The color change is smooth but the lower bands remain distinct, producing a clear chromatic horizon. Dark navy silhouettes gather close to the bottom edge, where an irregular organic mass balances a compact angular mass and a few thin vertical and horizontal marks. Cool ambient illumination washes pale surfaces toward turquoise, while one or two small amber apertures supply concentrated warm contrast. Most near-ground detail falls into dark, quiet values, so the broad color fields and crisp outline shapes carry the image. Fine wires and poles add a restrained linear rhythm without competing with the dominant open space. There are no heavy shadows or sharp beams; the fading ambient glow is diffuse, and local artificial light creates only short soft spill. The mood is still, vivid, and intimate, with vast cool space held against a low, small-scale cluster of warm details.
style_prompt_zh: 蓝调时分的摄影处理在狭窄的紫、亮粉和珊瑚橙色带上方铺开大片饱和青蓝。色彩转变平滑，但下部条带仍可分辨，形成清楚的色彩地平。深海军蓝剪影聚在下缘附近，一团不规则有机体块与一块紧凑棱角体块、少数细竖线和横线取得平衡。冷环境光将浅色表面染向青绿，一两处小琥珀色开口则提供集中的暖色对比。大多数近地细节落入安静的深暗色值，因此宽阔色域与清晰轮廓承担画面。细电线和竖杆增添克制线性节奏，却不与主导的开放空间竞争。没有厚重阴影或尖锐光束；消退的环境亮度是漫射的，局部人工光只形成短而柔的溢光。气氛静止、鲜明而亲近，大片冷色空间与低位、小尺度的暖色细节相互牵制。
theme_en: A small coastal house beside a tree at the vivid blue hour
theme_zh: 蓝调时分一棵树旁的海边小屋
name: Blue hour
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
